🏙️ Parametric City Builder (PRE-ALPHA)

QUICK TUTORIAL

• Toggle "Buy Land" to purchase land.
• You can only build roads on land that you own.
• Build farms to support your residential areas | No farms = no residential buildings.

Build your own city from the ground up! Design road networks, zone land, grow your population, manage crops, and watch your city evolve through procedural generation. Every server map is unique, featuring organic terrain generation. Choose between Residential, Commercial, Industrial, and Agricultural zones, customize building styles and densities, to balance your city's economy as it grows.

⚠️ This is a Pre-Alpha build. The game is not finished and is under active development. Expect bugs, missing features, balance changes, and frequent updates.

🖥️ PC Supported.
📱 Mobile & tablet: Available for TEST!
🎮 You can access the experience on console; however, mouse and keyboard are required.

⭐ Favorite the game and follow to support development!
